To be eligible for this program, Customers must be members in Active Duty, honorably discharged from, retired from, or on disability with the United States Armed Forces (including Reservists). Additionally, the spouse of those individuals is also eligible for this program.
The eligible customer must be able to provide one of the following: A current Earnings Statement. A copy of honorable discharge papers. A bank statement indicating a pension or disability earnings from the United States Armed Forces or an official document indicating future pension eligibility. This includes those that have national status from another country and are serving in the United States military. In order for a spouse to be eligible, they must provide one of the above listed pieces of documentation.

1.name: Military Program
1.description:
Eligible consumers include: active military, active military reserve, retired military (honorably discharged), and retired military reserve (honorably discharged). Eligible branches of the military are: Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, National Guard, Public Health Service Commissioned Corps and National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration Commissioned Officer Corps.
Program compatibility is available in DealerCONNECT.

1.name: Kia US Owner Loyalty Program

2.name: Military Specialty Incentive Program
2.description:
To be eligible for this program, Customers must be members in Active Duty, honorably discharged from, retired from, or on disability with the United States Armed Forces (including Reservists). Additionally, the spouse of those individuals is also eligible for this program.
The eligible customer must be able to provide one of the following: A current Earnings Statement. A copy of honorable discharge papers. A bank statement indicating a pension or disability earnings from the United States Armed Forces or an official document indicating future pension eligibility. This includes those that have national status from another country and are serving in the United States military. In order for a spouse to be eligible, they must provide one of the above listed pieces of documentation.

1.name: Military Program
1.description:
Eligible consumers include: active military, active military reserve, retired military (honorably discharged), and retired military reserve (honorably discharged). Honorably discharged veterans within 12 months of discharge date, and 100% disabled veterans are eligible. Eligible branches of the military are: Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, National Guard, Public Health Service Commissioned Corps and National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration Commissioned Officer Corps.
Program compatibility is available in DealerCONNECT.

2.name: National SFS Lease Loyalty Bonus Cash
2.description:
Customers who currently have a qualifying Stellantis vehicle, or who have had a contract expire within the last 365 calendar days of the program start date (if applicable per the Qualifying Program Criteria); and enter into a new purchase or lease of an eligible model are eligible to participate. No lease turn-in or trade-in is required to be eligible for this offer. Customer must finance or lease through Stellantis Financial Services to be eligible for this program. Residency restrictions may apply.
This program is not compatible with any Conquest Bonus Cash program. Program compatibility is available in DealerCONNECT.

lowest_finance_offer.name: SFS Standalone APR
lowest_finance_offer.description:
Residents residing in qualifying regions of the United States listed in the BUSINESS CENTER BOUNDARIES section. APR financing must go through Stellantis Financial Services. Customers must be considered 1/2 Tier. Customers who are considered Tier 3 and Tier 4 will have an increase rate.
This program is not compatible with most incentive programs including but not limited to: Consumer Cash Allowance, Combo Cash and Combo APR, Bonus Cash programs, affinity programs. This program is compatible with Employee Purchase, CDI, Dealership Rewards and Affiliate programs.

0.name: First Responder Bonus Consumer Cash
0.description:
Eligible consumers include: Police Officer, Sheriff/Sheriffs Deputy, Correctional officer, State Trooper, Federal Law Enforcement Officer, Career Firefighter, Volunteer Firefighter, EMT and Paramedic.
The vehicle sale or lease must be registered in either the name of the eligible participant or registered in the name of an immediate family member living in the same household. Program compatibility is available in DealerCONNECT.

1.name: Military Program
1.description:
Eligible consumers include: active military, active military reserve, retired military (honorably discharged), and retired military reserve (honorably discharged). Honorably discharged veterans within 12 months of discharge date, and 100% disabled veterans are eligible. Eligible branches of the military are: Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, National Guard, Public Health Service Commissioned Corps and National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration Commissioned Officer Corps.
Program compatibility is available in DealerCONNECT.

2.name: National SFS Lease Loyalty Bonus Cash
2.description:
Customers who currently have a qualifying Stellantis vehicle, or who have had a contract expire within the last 365 calendar days of the program start date (if applicable per the Qualifying Program Criteria); and enter into a new purchase or lease of an eligible model are eligible to participate. No lease turn-in or trade-in is required to be eligible for this offer. Customer must finance or lease through Stellantis Financial Services to be eligible for this program. Residency restrictions may apply.
This program is not compatible with any Conquest Bonus Cash program. Program compatibility is available in DealerCONNECT.

2.name: Military Specialty Incentive Program
2.description:

A bank statement indicating a pension or disability earnings from the United States Armed Forces or an official document indicating future pension eligibility. This includes those that have national status from another country and are serving in the United States military. In order for a spouse to be eligible, they must provide one of the above listed pieces of documentation.

In order for a spouse to be eligible, they must provide one of the above listed pieces of documentation.

0.description: Current registered owners of any 2016 or newer Kia model may be eligible for an Owner Loyalty Specialty Incentive when purchasing a new, eligible MY27 Telluride reported with a sale type of RSALE, KAPR, KLSE, and CSALE. All other sale types are not eligible.

1.name: Military Specialty Incentive Program
1.description:
To be eligible for this program, Customers must be members in Active Duty, honorably discharged from, retired from, or on disability with the United States Armed Forces (including Reservists). Additionally, the spouse of those individuals is also eligible for this program.
The eligible customer must be able to provide one of the following: A current Earnings Statement. A copy of honorable discharge papers. A bank statement indicating a pension or disability earnings from the United States Armed Forces or an official document indicating future pension eligibility. This includes those that have national status from another country and are serving in the United States military. In order for a spouse to be eligible, they must provide one of the above listed pieces of documentation.

2.name: Kia US Competitive Bonus Program
2.description: When utilizing the Competitive Bonus Program, the qualifying vehicle must be a MY 2016 or newer competitor vehicle and meet all applicable eligibility requirements. Customers must provide proof of qualifying competitor vehicle ownership, and the qualifying vehicle used for each occurrence may not be the same vehicle. Qualifying customers are limited to two (2) Specialty Incentive occurrences per calendar year, and all applicable program terms and conditions must be satisfied for the claim to be eligible.

1.name: Military Program
1.description:

Program compatibility is available in DealerCONNECT.

1.name: Military Program

Program compatibility is available in DealerCONNECT.
